Use case: Customer-service AI agent on website (order status, returns, refunds)
AI tool or vendor: In-house Python agent (chatbot_secure.py v2) on Anthropic Claude API (claude-haiku-5-5)
Data used: Order records; customer names and emails; knowledge-base policies and FAQs
Key risks: Knowledge-base poisoning or prompt injection causing unauthorised refunds (5/5 in red-team of v1); disclosure of other customers' data; cost flooding; made-up policy answers
Controls: SHA-256 knowledge-base allowlist; identity check and data minimisation; refund rules in code (auto only up to £50, above £50 goes to human approval); output redaction; rate limit and token budget; security event log; red-team re-test before each change (v2: 12/12 attacks blocked)

Use case: Drafting marketing copy (product descriptions, emails, social posts)
AI tool or vendor: ChatGPT (company Business workspace) and Microsoft 365 Copilot
Data used: Product specs; brand guidelines; public website content
Key risks: Inaccurate or misleading product claims (ASA/CAP Code); copyright issues; off-brand tone; staff pasting customer data
Controls: Approved business accounts only (no training on our data); no customer data; a person edits and approves before publishing; claims checked against product spec

AI tool or vendor: AI shortlisting feature in recruitment platform (vendor)
Key risks: Bias or discrimination against protected groups (Equality Act 2010); solely automated decisions about candidates (UK GDPR Art. 22); candidates not told AI is used; vendor reusing candidate data
Controls: AI ranks only, a person decides; no automatic rejections; DPIA completed before go-live; privacy notice tells candidates; quarterly check of shortlist vs applicant pool for bias; vendor contract bars training on our data

Key risks: Recording without people knowing; sensitive conversations captured; inaccurate summaries shared as fact; transcripts kept too long
Controls: Organiser announces transcription; switched off for HR, disciplinary and health conversations; organiser checks summary before sharing; retention follows Microsoft 365 policy

Data used: Browsing history; basket and order history
Key risks: Profiling without valid consent (cookies/PECR); unexpected use of shopping data; poor or unfair recommendations
Controls: Runs only with cookie consent; privacy notice explains it; vendor data processing agreement; quarterly check of recommendation quality

AI tool or vendor: Payment provider's machine-learning fraud scoring (e.g. Stripe Radar)
Data used: Transaction data; IP address; card metadata (not full card numbers)
Key risks: Genuine customers blocked (false positives); automated decision affecting customers; vendor model is opaque
Controls: Blocked orders over £100 reviewed by a person; customers can contact us to challenge a block; monthly false-positive review; vendor data processing agreement

Use case: Code suggestions for website and agent code
Key risks: Secrets or keys sent in prompts; insecure code suggestions; licence issues from copied public code
Controls: Business plan (code not used for training); secrets kept in .env and never committed; secret scanning on; every change code-reviewed; public-code filter switched on

Use case: Sales and stock forecasting in spreadsheets
Key risks: Wrong formulas or figures leading to over- or under-ordering
Controls: Person checks formulas and totals before use; forecasts signed off by Operations Manager

Key risks: Images that misrepresent the product (ASA); copyright in generated content
Controls: Edits limited to background and lighting; product itself must look as delivered; Marketing Manager approves before use

Use case: Unapproved 'shadow' AI use (personal or free AI accounts)
AI tool or vendor: Unknown (personal ChatGPT, free tools, browser extensions)
Data used: Unknown; could include customer, staff or financial data
Key risks: Confidential or personal data leaked to tools we have no contract with; no audit trail; data used to train public models
Controls: Responsible AI Use Policy; approved alternatives provided; staff briefing at induction and yearly; quarterly anonymous survey on AI use; any found use is moved to an approved route
